tool_analysis:
Step Analysis:
- The recorded browser session logs show a successful end-to-end demonstration against a Magento 1.9 admin: login (admin/password123), closing an "Incoming Message" popup, opening the Customers grid, opening the Add New Customer form, applying column filters (Name, Email, Group, Website), clicking Search, using Export, selecting a row and applying a mass action (Subscribe to Newsletter), and opening the per-row Edit page for the matched customer (ID 210).

Task Definition (single purpose):
- Provide a reusable, parameterized automation tool that: 1) navigates to the Magento admin customers list, 2) closes the incoming message popup if present, 3) applies column filters (id/name/email/telephone/group/website), 4) runs Search, 5) optionally exports results in a chosen format, 6) optionally selects the matched rows and applies a mass action (with optional group selection), and 7) opens the Edit page for the matched customer. The tool will also extract the filtered grid and the opened edit page content for verification.

Action Plan (ordered deterministic steps):
1) Navigation: go to the provided customers-list URL ({base_url}).
2) Click: close the incoming message popup to reveal controls (deterministic click using elementHash captured during recording).
3) Input: fill the Name column filter with {name} using the recorded Name filter input elementHash.
4) Input: fill the Email column filter with {email} using the recorded Email filter input elementHash.
5) Input: fill the Telephone column filter with {telephone} using a robust XPath (no stable elementHash recorded for this control in logs).
6) Select: choose Customer Group from the recorded Group select element (elementHash present) using visible option text {group}.
7) Select: choose Website from the recorded Website select element (elementHash present) using visible option text {website}.
8) Click: trigger 'Search' using the recorded Search button elementHash to apply filters.
9) Wait/Extract: extract the filtered grid contents into output key 'search_results' for verification.
10) Click: (optional but parameter-driven) trigger Export by clicking the export anchor that matches {export_format} visible text (CSV/Excel/XML). This uses a robust XPath that matches export anchors by text + href pattern.
11) Click: select the matched row's checkbox (deterministic elementHash recorded for the matched row checkbox in the session) to prepare for mass action.
12) Select: choose the mass-action option using the recorded mass-action select elementHash with visible text {mass_action}.
13) Select: if an assign-group value is provided, select it in the group select that appears (robust XPath used for group select inside massaction container).
14) Click: click the mass-action Submit button (deterministic elementHash recorded) to apply the action.
15) Click: open the per-row Edit link (deterministic elementHash recorded during the session) to open the customer edit page.
16) Extract: capture the opened Edit page content to output 'customer_edit_data'.

Variable Identification (inputs needed):
- base_url (string, required) - full customers list URL (e.g. "http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin/customer/").
- name (string, optional) - value to type into the Name filter input (exact visible name text expected).
- email (string, optional) - value to type into the Email filter input.
- telephone (string, optional) - value to type into telephone filter (uses name/id-based XPath fallback if no stable elementHash).
- group (string, optional) - visible option text for customer group filter (e.g. "Wholesale").
- website (string, optional) - visible option text for website filter (e.g. "Main Website").
- export_format (string, optional; enum: ["csv","excel","xml"]) - export choice (visible/anchor text). If omitted, export step will attempt to click an anchor using the provided text (caller should provide this when an export is desired).
- mass_action (string, optional; enum: ["Delete","Subscribe to Newsletter","Unsubscribe from Newsletter","Assign a Customer Group"]) - visible text of the mass-action to apply.
- assign_group (string, optional) - visible text of target customer group when mass_action == "Assign a Customer Group".
- open_edit (bool, optional) - when true, the tool will click the Edit link for the matched row (the recording contains a deterministic Edit anchor for the matched customer). Default: true (tool demonstrates Edit navigation by default).

Step Optimization and Selector Decisions:
- Where the recording provided stable elementHash identifiers, this tool uses those deterministic elementHash-backed interactions (close popup, Name input, Email input, Group select, Website select, Search, Export button, row checkbox, massaction select, massaction submit, Edit link). Those elementHash targets are recorded as stable in the session and are preferred for repeatable automation.
- For controls that did not have a stable elementHash recorded (e.g., Telephone filter or the dynamic group select that appears when choosing 'Assign a Customer Group'), the tool uses robust XPath/CSS selectors based on column header text, name attributes, or href patterns as provided by the session analysis. This preserves reliability across Magento 1.x admin variants.
- Navigation optimization: the tool uses direct navigation to the provided base_url instead of clicking through menus (faster and deterministic). For opening an Edit page the tool uses the recorded Edit anchor click which navigates to the canonical edit URL (stable href pattern '/admin/customer/edit/id/<id>/').
- No authentication steps are included because the recorded session assumed an already-authenticated admin session (per developer instructions).

Deterministic mapping (elementHash references captured from recording):
- popup_close_elementHash: "df76c6ce85"
- filter_name_elementHash: "958237192c"
- filter_email_elementHash: "56a5f4823b"
- filter_group_elementHash: "547d16e240"
- filter_website_elementHash: "4a2f7e5061"
- search_button_elementHash: "1e357d7581"
- export_button_elementHash: "2e06ace4ae" (used as fallback if export anchor cannot be found by text)
- row_checkbox_elementHash: "822a6e2ce4"
- massaction_select_elementHash: "b202e94e0d"
- massaction_submit_elementHash: "4bc86290e0"
- edit_link_elementHash: "72c7179015"

Essential-only policy: the tool performs only the actions required by the core task: navigate → close popup → set filters → search → export (parameter-driven) → select rows & apply mass action (parameter-driven) → open Edit → extract results. It does not include extraneous exploratory clicks, optional UI discovery steps, or branching logic.

Notes on reliability and required parameters:
- Search/filter inputs are optional; providing empty strings will effectively leave a filter blank. When passing export_format or mass_action, provide the exact visible option text (case-insensitive) used by the admin UI (examples included in input schema). Because the tool uses recorded elementHash selectors from the session, running this tool against a different Magento admin instance (different theme or heavy customizations) may require adjusting the fallback selectors.
name: magento_admin_customer_find_and_operate_tool_v1
description: Find customers in Magento Admin (customers grid) using filters and perform actions: export, mass-action, and open Edit. Uses recorded, deterministic selectors captured from a successful recorded session (Magento 1.9). Input-driven: provide filter values, export format and mass action to apply. The tool assumes an already-authenticated admin session.

steps.description: Navigate directly to the Magento admin customers list page (starting URL).
Close the 'Incoming Message' popup to make the grid controls accessible (deterministic selector captured in recording).
Type the provided Name filter into the Name filter input (recorded elementHash).
Type the provided Email filter into the Email filter input (recorded elementHash).
Type the provided Telephone filter using a robust XPath (no stable elementHash recorded for telephone filter in logs).
Select the provided Customer Group visible option (recorded Group select elementHash).
Select the provided Website visible option (recorded Website select elementHash).
Click the Search / Apply Filters button to refresh the grid with the provided filters (recorded Search button elementHash).
Short wait to allow the grid to refresh after Search.
Extract the grid contents so the caller can inspect the filtered rows.
steps.goal: Capture the filtered customer grid rows and metadata (total count, per-row id/name/email/edit links).

steps.description: Click the Export link matching the export_format (CSV/Excel/XML). If {export_format} is empty this will try to match nothing; caller should supply this when export is desired.
Click the row checkbox for the matched result row (deterministic checkbox elementHash recorded for the matched customer row).
Select the requested mass-action option from the massaction dropdown (recorded massaction select elementHash).
If 'Assign a Customer Group' is chosen, select the visible group option from the group select that appears in the massaction container (robust XPath fallback).
Click the mass-action Submit button to apply the chosen action to the selected rows (deterministic elementHash recorded).
Short wait for mass-action server response/refresh.
Click the per-row Edit link for the matched row to open the customer edit page (deterministic edit anchor elementHash captured during recording).
Extract the edit page content so the caller can confirm navigation and view captured fields like firstname, lastname, email and form_key.
steps.goal: Capture the opened customer Edit page HTML/content for verification (customer_edit_data).

input_schema.name: name
input_schema.description: Value to type into the Name filter (visible text). Leave empty to skip.

input_schema.name: email
input_schema.description: Value to type into the Email filter. Leave empty to skip.

input_schema.name: telephone
input_schema.description: Value to type into the Telephone filter. Leave empty to skip.

input_schema.name: group
input_schema.description: Visible option text for the Group filter (e.g. "Wholesale"). Leave empty to skip.

input_schema.name: website
input_schema.description: Visible option text for the Website filter (e.g. "Main Website"). Leave empty to skip.

input_schema.name: export_format
input_schema.description: Export format to click (CSV, Excel, XML). Provide one of the enum values in lowercase to trigger export.

input_schema.name: mass_action
input_schema.description: Visible text of mass-action to apply to selected rows. If omitted, no mass action will be meaningfully applied.

input_schema.name: assign_group
input_schema.description: Visible group option text used when mass_action is 'Assign a Customer Group' (e.g. 'General').

input_schema.name: open_edit
input_schema.description: When true, the tool will click the Edit link for the matched row after actions. Default: true.
